purpose: Make branch A's confidence signals measure 'enrolment match' instead of 'session similarity'. Reuse the E180 EEGNet backbone / data pipeline, keep the adversarial objective, and add an explicit cross-session invariance constraint between two mutually exclusive strong perturbation families. Then freeze, recompute the five gate signals, check whether the four branch-A confidence signals flip from Test AUC ~0.40 to >0.5, and rerun the gate fusion + ten gates.

frozen_source.reuse: data pipeline (Train session1 only, 18x1200 @300Hz), Net, augment, PGD trainer, branch B (E65 PCA-96 / k=12 prototypes)
frozen_source.note: E182 never writes into any existing experiment directory

branch_a_v2.architecture: identical to E180 branch A: Conv1d(18->32,k9,s2)-BN-ELU -> (32->64) -> (64->128) -> (128->128) -> global avg pool -> Linear(128,20)
branch_a_v2.consistency: L = mean(1 - cosine(embed(x_A), embed(x_B))) on the 128-d pooled pre-head embedding (no dropout in the embedding path)
branch_a_v2.consistency_weight_selection: two selection models (lambda=0.1 / 0.3) trained on blocks != 3 (20 epochs); lambda = argmax best eval-window (0.6<frac<=0.8) clean accuracy, tie-break smaller lambda; Train-only
branch_a_v2.base_augmentation: E180 augment applied once and shared by both views (time shift, channel dropout 0.1, amplitude 0.9-1.1, noise SNR 20-30 dB)
branch_a_v2.early_stop: full model only: best eval-window (0.6<frac<=0.8) clean accuracy

perturbation_A_electrode.note: per-channel N(1, 0.10) gain + per-channel N(0, 0.15*RMS) bias + channel dropout 0.15

perturbation_B_spectral.note: per-sample per-band N(1, 0.15) gains over the five E65 bands (1-40 Hz) + 0.1-1 Hz drift + linear ramp + additive noise SNR 15-25 dB

branch_a_v2.time_budget: selection 2x20 epochs + 5 folds x 24 epochs + full 30 epochs, target < 20 min on RTX 3080 Laptop

signals.g_dist: branch B score = -nearest-prototype euclidean distance (E180 gate), z-scored by Train OOF mean/std
signals.g_margin: branch A top1 - top2 softmax probability
signals.g_entropy: branch A sum p log p (= -entropy)
signals.orientation: all five oriented so larger = more likely known; z-scored with Train OOF mean/std (population std, Train-only)
signals.train_reference: 5-block OOF logits of branch A v2 + frozen E180 branch-B 5-block OOF scores
signals.test: frozen full v2 model logits + frozen E180 branch-B prototypes

fusion.candidates: 5 singles + 10 pairs x w in {0.1..0.9} + 10 triple equal + 5 four-way + 1 five-way (111 total)
fusion.selection_rule: argmax pooled Train LOSO gate AUC; ties broken by fold-mean AUC then fewer signals
fusion.forbidden: no Test metric, threshold or Session field may influence weights / thresholds / PCA / prototypes / model choice

threshold.rule: tau(a) = quantile(Train OOF fused score, 1 - a)

loso_probe.eval_rows: 0.6 < frac <= 0.8: known = enrolled identities, unknown = held-out identity
loso_probe.why: production model saw all 20 identities; a leave-identity-out probe is the only honest Train-side measurement of the confidence signals

attack.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, same subset as E180/E181

goals.B: broad confusion on the identity head
goals.C: boundary impersonation on the identity head
goals.D: gate evasion: maximise the fused gate score

attack.status: self-built white-box PGD surrogate, not the official attack suite

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test predictions are written before the Session column is read; Session is only used for the #9/#10 audit and the signal-orientation diagnostic
